# Celoris
India's free creative studio since 2019. Free video editor, image studio, 20+ AI models, online classes, and daily freelance gigs. No credit card required. Built for creators and learners in India.

## Core Features & Syllabi
- [Free Online Video Editor](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/video-studio) - High-performance timeline-based browser video editor.
- [Creative Image Studio](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/image-studio) - Design assets, remove backgrounds, and compose graphics.
- [AI Explorer](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/ai-explorer) - Explore 20+ state-of-the-art AI models for text, image, and video generation.
- [Teach & Earn Platform](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/teach) - Join as a trainer, host classes, and monetize expertise.
- [Earn Gigs Marketplace](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/earn) - Daily freelance and creation gigs for creators.

## Featured Syllabi

### AI & Developer Courses
- [Vibe Coding Mastery](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/vibe-coding-mastery) - App building where AI does the heavy lifting.
- [Mastering Multimodal AI](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/mastering-multimodal-ai) - Build with Vision, Voice, and Multi-modal APIs.
- [Accelerating Science with GenAI](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/accelerating-science-generative-ai-for-research-innovation) - Generative AI for academic and industrial research.
- [Agentic AI Systems Design](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/agentic-ai-systems-design-build-deploy) - Build and scale production-ready AI agent frameworks.
- [LangChain in Action](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/langchain-in-action-real-workflows) - Orchestrate real-world LLM flows and agents.

### Professional Skills & Academics
- [Digital Marketing with AI Tools](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/digital-marketing-using-ai-tools) - Lead generation, SEO, and copywriting.
- [Adobe Photoshop with AI](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/adobe-photoshop-with-ai) - Next-gen photo editing and manipulation.
- [CBSE Class 10 Physics Master Course](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/courses/cbse-class-10-physics-light-electricity-magnetism-energy) - Complete course covering light, electricity, and energy.
- [Microsoft Excel Advanced Training](https://www.celorisdesigns.com/microsoft-excel-training-noida) - Advanced functions, pivot tables, and VBA.
